name: iperson1337/nct-client-bundle
description: Symfony client for the National Catalog of Goods of Kazakhstan (НКТ): nationalcatalog.kz portal API (product requests, attributes, dictionaries) and nct.gov.kz public lookups, with retries, rate limiting and typed errors

suggest.ext-redis: Redis-backed sliding-window rate limiter shared between processes (phpredis)
suggest.predis/predis: Redis-backed rate limiter without the phpredis extension
